market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: While Marco Rubio could run in 2028, he faces a crowded GOP field and a strong Democratic opponent. The 14.1% implied odds overprice his chances; a more calibrated probability is around 5%, making 'No' a favorable bet.
evidence_points: Long-shot presidential bids rarely command >10% probability 4 years out, given field uncertainty.
Rubio's prior presidential bid (2016) did not secure the nomination, and other Republicans like DeSantis or Vance may be better positioned.
The market may reflect short-term speculation rather than fundamentals.
